svg.title: AI Product Intake - Create Bug and Create Feature wireframes
svg.desc: Phase 0 design for initiative AI-assisted product intake. Separate Create Bug / Create Feature entry on Product page; shared intake shell; analyze / clarify / plan / draft-review / create-all. Schemas: AI_PRODUCT_INTAKE_PARSER_SCHEMAS.md. Attachments reuse AttachmentPanel + intakeSessionId.
svg.text: AI Product Intake — Create Bug & Create Feature
Hub: AI-assisted product intake (cmpblw2ha000bms0q127a8ueq). Schemas: AI_PRODUCT_INTAKE_PARSER_SCHEMAS.md. Phase 0 — approve before coding.
Locked decisions: separate buttons · Custom P0–P3 + Discovery · clarify vague features · AC by default · bugs = Feature storyType BUG · draft-all / confirm-each.
Opens shared intake shell with mode=bug | feature and productId bound.
Paste text, drop screenshot, or paste a Notion / Jira / Slack URL...
Login CTA is clipped on iPhone SE after rotate...
Typing debounced · paste/upload/link triggers analyze immediately.
Session stores source metadata + attachment links (intakeSessionId).
Shown when vagueness score is high
1. Who is the primary user / persona?
2. What outcome should be true when done?
3. Is this a bug, feature, or exploration (Discovery)?
Max 2–3 questions. Bug mode uses placement options instead when routing confidence is low.
Planner output before full drafts · user can reclassify / split / merge / remove
Rationale: three related backlog items under one epic for intake ship.
Clipped CTA on mobile rotate → Feature storyType BUG + Requirements
severity HIGH → priority P1 (editable) · parent: epic above
priority P1 · rationale shown after draft · AC default on
Maps hubEntityType to Initiative | Feature | Requirement. Mixed bug+feature sets allowed.
E. Draft review — generate all, confirm each
Create all only after every included item is explicitly approved
AI fields marked; edits flip to user-edited
- CTA fully visible after rotate on iPhone SE
- No horizontal clip in portrait or landscape
Partial create OK · created rows link to intake session + attachments. Disabled until >=1 approved.
URL fetch failure: same banner + paste-content fallback. Session audit keeps fetch status.
Phase 1 code slice (after this SVG approved)
• Shared shell UI wired to AttachmentPanel
• Stub analyze returning empty plan (no fake backlog write)
Attachments (intakeSessionId) · VoiceMic later · existing Feature/Requirement create APIs
Real LLM planner/parsers · draft batch create · external URL fetch
1 Foundation → 2 Planner → 3 Bug parser → 4 Feature parser → 5 Draft review → 6 URL fetch
Do not mutate hub backlog from analyze until Create all in Phase 5.
A. Under initiative “Q2 Client & platform UX” (recommended 0.62)
Add Requirements only under existing Feature
C. New initiative under this product
Epic + BUG Feature when no good parent found
J. Feature priority — Custom Tymio model
Unblocks Create Bug/Feature on Product page; aligns with NOW P1 intake epic;
moderate effort; no external blocker. Not P0 (no revenue/outage).
User can override priority; rationale stays for audit. Discovery = explore without committing Feature ship.
Layout: Product header actions always visible (desktop). Intake = centered modal ~640px desktop; full-sheet mobile.
Colors: Bug CTA #dc2626 · Feature CTA #2563eb · Primary actions #0f172a · chips per ontology type.
Typography: match app shell (existing sans). No purple glow / pill clusters. Cards only where interaction requires grouping (plan items, drafts).
Inputs v1: text, images, PDF/MD/TXT/DOCX, pasted URLs (fetch in Phase 6). OCR via analyze pipeline when image attached.
API sketch: POST /api/intake-sessions · PATCH raw · POST analyze · POST plan · POST drafts · POST commit — see PARSER_SCHEMAS.md.
Audit: channel, timestamps, rawExcerptHash, fetchStatus, confidence, aiVsUser field flags on drafts.
Severity→priority default: CRITICAL→P0, HIGH→P1, MEDIUM→P2, LOW→P3 (user override both).
Tests (later): Product buttons open modes; session persists attachments; analyze debounce; clarify gate; plan edit; approve gate on Create all; no hub write before commit.
Approve this SVG (+ schemas doc) before Phase 1 implementation. Changes after approval require SVG update first.
Related: FILE_PASTE_ANNOTATE_WIREFRAMES.svg (attachments) · VOICE_CAPTURE (mic later) · Hub feature cmpblw662000dms0qnlgcrydu (foundation).
